title: Possible an Okta API token in an Authorization SSWS header in source
description: The file contains an Okta API token in an Authorization SSWS header. Header values are copied into clients, tests and proxy configuration, so a committed one authorises every reader until it is revoked. Shape-only: the match does not prove the token is live.
remediation: Revoke the token at the service, replace the literal header with a value loaded at run time from a secret manager, and check client bundles and logs for the same value.
limitation: Shape-only, case-insensitive match on a specific header name followed by a token-shaped value. It cannot prove the token is valid, and it does not see headers assembled dynamically.

tests.line: # Authorization: SSWS comes from the agent
